name: feedbacks
description: Visual website feedback, team discussion and reviewer context for coding assistants.

interface.shortDescription: Read visual feedback and discuss it with your team.
interface.longDescription: Connect to your chosen Feedbacks server. Read screenshots, complete discussion and approved reviewer guidance; reply and attach evidence within your granted project scope.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read the Feedbacks thread for this task, including its screenshot, discussion and approved reviewer guidance. Summarize the request before making authorized changes.
